  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.


Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!


A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos 507 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 31 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.


Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. description:

  • Motivation to continually learn, experiment, improve, and share knowledge with others

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and either Portuguese or Spanish
  • Experience working with new cloud technology (Kubernetes and its service offering on various cloud platforms)

Preferred Skills

title: Project Development Director Latam

title: Senior Manager/Director of Consumer Communications
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage!

Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China!

Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.


About the Role

The Senior Manager of Consumer Communications - Press & KOLs for Brazil at Keeta will integrate the Communications Team of Keeta and work directly with Keeta´s leadership team in the country to help develop and execute the full Consumer Comms strategy of the company, which is entering the local market focusing on robust expansion and generating strong positive impact in the food delivery industry by bringing new technology and great expertise.

This position reports to the Head of Public Relations in Brazil and requires extensive external Communications experience in innovative and fast-paced companies, preferably in the technology segment. Knowledge and experience in the food, beverage, or food delivery segments is a plus. Experience working with both traditional media and KOLs/social media is also required. Fluent Portuguese and English are required.

The Senior Manager of Consumer Communications - Press & KOLs will be responsible for planning and executing Comms strategies and campaigns in Brazil, interacting directly with media, journalists and KOLs and also managing an external PR agency, in order to:

  • Increase the impact of brand awareness in Brazil.
  • Improve brand favorability.
  • Maintain or improve tonality of earned media stories.
  • Maintain integrated brand campaigns (cross-functional work with Marketing, Social Media, Business, Government Affairs and Internal Comms teams).
  • Manage crisis/mitigate negative PR impact


Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 30 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

Job Description:

The Data Migration Specialist is responsible for transitioning and transforming data from legacy systems to new platforms. The specialist will ensure data integrity, security, and accessibility throughout the migration process, thus supporting the organization's strategic initiatives and operational efficiency. The professional will proactively identify and mitigate risks, ensuring a smooth and successful transition with minimal disruption to business operations.


Main Responsibilities:

  • Data Migration and Transformation: Design and implement data migration processes. Develop scripts, ETL processes ( Extract, Transform, Load ) and tools for data migration, adapted to the specific requirements of the project. Utilize SQL, data mapping, and transformation techniques to optimize efficiency.
  • Data Integrity and Quality: Ensure data integrity and validation during the migration process. Perform regular audits and validation checks to verify the accuracy and completeness of the migrated data. Oversee user acceptance testing (UAT) and adjust the migration approach as needed.
  • Project and Risk Management: Plan and manage data migration projects, including resource allocation and schedule management. Identify and mitigate the risks associated with data migration, developing proactive strategies to address potential challenges.
  • Compliance and Governance: Ensuring that data migration processes comply with industry standards and regulations. Adhere to organizational policies and procedures.
  • Documentation and Communication: Generate regular progress reports for stakeholders. Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for all data migration activities, ensuring transparency, accountability, and knowledge sharing.


Essential Requirements (Hard Skills):

  • Experience: Minimum of 8 to 10 years of experience. At least 5 years of experience in data migration and management.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • Technical Tools and Skills:
  • Proficiency in SQL and data migration tools like Talend, Informatica .
  • Experience with database management systems (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle ) to manage and migrate data.
  • Proven knowledge and experience in the design and implementation of ETL processes.


Soft Skills:

  • Problem Solving: Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Communication: Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail.
  • Adaptability: Ability to work independently and in a team.
  • Project Management: Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.


Differentials (Nice to Have):

  • Education: Master's degree in a related field.

  • Knowledge: Experience with data migration to the cloud (AWS, Azure ). Familiarity with agile project management methodologies. Knowledge of data security and privacy regulations.
  • Languages: Ability to communicate in English and/or French is an asset.

title: Technical Service Engineer - Building Materials (Mortar Powder & Coatings)
description:
About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled Technical Service Engineer to provide expert technical support and solutions for our Mortar Powder & building material coatings product lines. This role combines hands-on field troubleshooting, customer training, and collaboration with R&D to optimize product performance and ensure customer satisfaction in construction, industrial, and architectural markets.


Responsibilities:

  • Technical Support & Troubleshooting
  • Serve as the primary technical contact for customers, distributors, and sales teams, resolving issues related to product application, performance, and compatibility (e.g., adhesion failure, curing defects, durability concerns).
  • Conduct on-site visits to diagnose problems and recommend solutions for Mortar Powder (e.g., concrete additives, mortar mixes) and coatings (e.g., epoxy, waterproofing, decorative finishes).
  • Product Training & Documentation
  • Develop and deliver technical training programs for customers, contractors, and internal teams on product usage, safety protocols, and best practices.
  • Create detailed technical documentation, including application guides, safety data sheets (SDS), and troubleshooting manuals.
  • Product Optimization & Testing
  • Collaborate with R&D and QA teams to improve product formulations based on field feedback and performance data.
  • Perform lab and field tests to validate product compatibility with substrates (concrete, wood, metal) and environmental conditions (humidity, temperature).
  • Compliance & Sustainability
  • Ensure products meet industry standards (e.g., ISO, ASTM) and environmental regulations (e.g., low VOC, REACH compliance).
  • Advocate for sustainable solutions, such as eco-friendly coatings or recycled sand powder applications.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Support sales teams by participating in client meetings, demonstrating product value, and addressing technical inquiries during pre- and post-sales phases.
  • Work with supply chain to address logistics or raw material challenges impacting product performance.


Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemistry, or related field. Advanced degrees or certifications (e.g., NACE, SSPC) are a plus. 3+ years of experience in technical service, R&D, or application engineering within the building materials, coatings, or construction chemicals industry. Sherwin williams,Sika,etc are preferred.


Required Skills:

  • In-depth knowledge of Mortar Powder applications (e.g., cementitious systems) and coating technologies (e.g., epoxy, polyurethane, acrylic).
  • Proficiency in laboratory testing methods, data analysis, and root-cause analysis for product failures.
  • Familiarity with CAD software, simulation tools, or digital tools for technical documentation is advantageous.


Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with green building certifications (e.g., LEED, BREEAM).
  • Multilingual skills for roles supporting global markets (e.g., Spanish, Portuguese, Mandarin).
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% for customer site visits and industry events.

title: Subject Matter Expert-Technical Support
description:
Role: Technical Support Subject Matter Expert-Trilingual in Portuguese+Spanish+English

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil

Salary: BRL 3300/month

Primary Work Environment

This position will be a resource for level 1 and level 2 support analysts to resolve problems requiring a greater level of technical expertise and/or time. Level 3 support analysts can expect to spend most of their time researching and resolving technical problems/issues and may be required to work as primary Level 1/2 staff if shorthanded. Technical information training and dissemination to global service desk staff is key for this role. Responsibility for creating, updating, and reviewing Solutions Center owned knowledge base documents is a normal daily activity. There may be large/small project involvement when Solutions Center resources are needed, or information needs to be disseminated to Solutions Center staff globally. This position will require frequent interaction between Solutions Center staff, other IT groups, and management. Travel to other sites to address end user issues may be required.

Responsibilities

  1. Internal service desk escalator for issues requiring more extensive troubleshooting, investigation, or time for resolution.
  2. Advanced end user technical resolution on items such as PC hardware and software issues; software installations and upgrades.
  3. Provide advanced support duties for applications, network, server, and security functions where interaction is required with the appropriate IT functional teams all in support of addressing end user issues. This generally coincides with advanced privileges in various areas.
  4. Support for labs, special builds, VIPs, and emergency support on a scheduled or ad hoc basis; often at the request of the Solutions Center Manager / Team Lead (as needed).
  5. Population and maintenance of Solutions Center owned knowledge base documents.
  6. Proactive recognition and resolution of end user and IT support issues to maintain a high level of visibility within the end user community.
  7. Participate in projects and incident reviews that will enhance the quality of the Solutions Center service level and promote technical and career growth.
  8. Participate in interview process for level 1 and 2 support analysts in region (where applicable).
  9. Train all new regional Solutions Center and support staff.
  10. Coach, mentor and educate level 1 and level 2 support analysts on critical thinking, end user experience and technical skills to solve end user issues.
  11. Perform data center support tasks supporting follow the sun model (where applicable).
  12. Fill in for primary level 1 and 2 solutions center tasks when needed based on volume, staffing or emergency.
  13. Attend global team meetings when needed (may be off hours).
  14. Perform Major Incident Escalation Coordinator activities to ensure a timely and efficient resolution of incidents that are impacting the business (may be off hours).

Recommended Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have a four-year technical degree and/or 3-6 years of related experience and will possess the following skills and abilities:

  1. Excellent communication skills including active listening skills and ability to convey empathy.
  2. Customer service skills with the ability to provide consistent, positive end user experiences and address issues proactively.
  3. Analytical problem-solving skills with the ability to use all available resources to resolve or anticipate problems, in turn creating or updating processes, procedures, and resolutions in the knowledgebase as needed.
  4. Time management skills including setting appropriate expectations with end users for resolution.
  5. Ability to be a team player, offering and accepting feedback and sharing knowledge with others, while being able to work independently and require minimal supervision.
  6. Relationship-building skills including the ability to develop intra- and inter-team relationship as well as build and establish rapport with end users efficiently.
  7. Multi-tasking abilities while focusing on effective prioritization of work.
  8. Identify and seek out opportunities for continuous improvement.
  9. Independent worker with the ability to define and share work plans, communicate on a timely and appropriate basis, all while requiring minimal supervision.


The ideal candidate will also have knowledge in, and familiarity with, the following:

  1. Microsoft Windows 10 / 11
  2. Office 365 applications including Teams, OneDrive, Outlook, and OneNote
  3. Microsoft Internet Explorer and Edge, Google Chrome, and Safari
  4. Adobe Acrobat, Foxit Reader, or other PDF applications
  5. ServiceNow
  6. VMware Horizon View
  7. Palo Alto Global Protect (VPN)
  8. iOS/Android devices
  9. System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM)
  10. Windows Internals
  11. Networking Fundamentals
  12. Information Security Fundamentals
  13. Server Fundamentals
  14. SAP

Implementar novas tecnologias: Avaliar e propor a adoção de novas tecnologias e ferramentas que possam otimizar a gestão de sinistros e melhorar a experiência do cliente;

  • Acompanhamento e Condução de Projetos Estratégicos: Liderar e monitorar projetos estratégicos que impactam diretamente os objetivos da empresa, garantindo execução eficaz e alinhamento com as metas de longo prazo.
  • Identificação de Novos Negócios e Oportunidades: Apoiar a Presidência e a Diretoria Executiva na avaliação de novos negócios e oportunidades de crescimento, analisando a viabilidade estratégica e financeira de iniciativas que maximizem o valor da companhia.
  • Análise de Cenários e Desenvolvimento de Insights de Mercado: Identificar tendências setoriais, comportamento do cliente e oportunidades de mercado, direcionando o portfólio de projetos e decisões de investimentos.
  • Elaboração de Materiais Executivos: Desenvolver apresentações e materiais executivos de alto nível para a Direx de Planejamento Estratégico, Presidência e Diretoria Executiva, comunicando de forma clara e objetiva as estratégias e os resultados de iniciativas estratégicas.
  • Estabelecimento de Metas e Indicadores Estratégicos: Definir e monitorar KPIs estratégicos e operacionais, assegurando que as metas da empresa estejam alinhadas com os resultados esperados e proporcionando visibilidade contínua de performance para a alta liderança.
  • Implementação de Práticas de Gestão e Eficiência Operacional: Desenvolver ferramentas e processos de gestão que promovam eficiência e otimização de recursos, maximizando o retorno das iniciativas estratégicas.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação Acadêmica e Experiência : Graduação em Administração, Economia ou áreas afins, com Pós-graduação ou MBA em Finanças, Planejamento Estratégico ou Negócios. Experiência comprovada em planejamento estratégico, preferencialmente em empresas de grande porte.
  • Visão Estratégica e Capacidade de Articulação : Perfil consultivo e integrador, com habilidade para interpretar e traduzir complexidades do negócio em ações e oportunidades de alto impacto, conectando diferentes áreas e promovendo uma visão unificada.
  • Comunicação e Influência : Habilidade para comunicar-se de forma clara e influenciar decisões estratégicas, interagindo efetivamente com a Direx de Planejamento Estratégico, Presidência e Diretoria Executiva.
  • Inglês Avançado : Essencial para interações e apresentações em contextos internacionais.

title: Analista Controles Fiduciários Sr
description:
Estamos em busca de profissionais com perfil analítico, crítico e colaborativo para atuar na área de Controle Fiduciário, com foco em conciliação de fundos de investimento, abrangendo renda fixa e outros instrumentos do mercado de capitais.

O profissional apoiará a implantação e parametrização de um novo sistema, além da análise e otimização de processos existentes, construção de bases de dados e desenvolvimento de projetos estratégicos da área.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar as conciliações dos ativos dos fundos de investimento (renda fixa, estruturada e variável);
  • Atuar com o sistema Sinqia – suporte à estruturação, análise de resultados e parametrizações;
  • Analisar processos já existentes e propor melhorias operacionais e sistêmicas;
  • Participar da construção de projetos internos na implantação de sistema Dash;
  • Apoiar na integração e desenvolvimento de banco de dados, além de dashboards de controle e performance;
  • Garantir o pleno funcionamento das rotinas diárias e no cumprimento dos prazos de fechamento de mercado.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Formação em Administração, Economia, Finanças ou áreas correlatas;
  • Vivência anterior em controle fiduciário, conciliação passiva;

  • Seguro de Vida
  • Auxílio Creche: Apoio financeiro para conciliar trabalho e responsabilidades familiares.

title: Especialista de Alocação e Produtos - Renda Fixa
description:

title: Network Engineer (LATAM)
description:
SONDA is the largest IT service provider in Latin America, leader in systems integration, support and IT outsourcing. With almost 50 years of experience and in constant growth around the World, and growing so far in in US, as well.


We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Network Engineer to join a strategic project with one of our key clients in the US.


This role involves designing, implementing, and maintaining secure and reliable network infrastructures across multiple technologies, with a strong focus on Cisco, Palo Alto, and Juniper platforms. The position offers the opportunity to work in an international environment with direct impact on critical client operations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, configure, and maintain network infrastructure, including Cisco routers/switches, Palo Alto firewalls, and Juniper devices.
  • Ensure network security, performance, and scalability across hybrid environments.
  • Support and troubleshoot complex network issues, providing timely resolutions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional and client teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Participate in network upgrades, migrations, and transformation initiatives.
  • Document configurations, processes, and procedures to ensure knowledge transfer.


Qualifications

  • Advanced English is a requirement.
  • Proven experience as a Network Engineer working with Cisco, Palo Alto, and Juniper technologies.
  • Strong understanding of routing, switching, VPNs, and firewall management.
  • Experience in enterprise-level projects involving complex network environments.
  • Hands-on experience with troubleshooting, diagnostics, and monitoring tools.
  • Strong communication skills in English to interact with U.S.-based stakeholders.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in migration projects , particularly within supply chain environments .
  • Relevant certifications (CCNP, PCNSE, JNCIP or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with cloud networking and hybrid infrastructure.

title: Sales Operation Manager (SMB)
description:
About US：

Keeta is an independent brand of Meituan, the world's largest tech-driven retail company. We focus on food and consumer product delivery services in international markets with the mission: "We help people eat better, live better".

Established in March 2010, Meituan has helped transform the supply and demand of service and product retail across the digital landscape.

As Meituan and Keeta continue to increase R&D investment and advance in new technologies, we uphold a customer-centric approach, working with our partners to provide quality services to customers.


What You'll Do:

1. Sales Process Optimization: Understand the whole BD process and operation pain points of the SMB team, promote the production and research team to build sales tools, establish a standardized operation process, and improve the team's operational efficiency

2. Sales Tool Development: Identify key points that constrain sales productivity improvement, and drive the product and research teams to develop and implement sales tools.

3. Merchant Tool Development: Identify merchant needs and pain points, and promote optimization of merchant-side product capabilities to enhance online operational efficiency for merchants.

4. Project Management: Utilize project management to ensure the successful implementation of key business goals and strategies. Mobilize resources from the strategy, product, and operations teams to effectively support the SMB team in achieving its business goals.


What We Need From You:

1. Experience: more than 2 years of experience in merchant operations, promotion preparations, and sales team operations.

2. Data analysis skills: proficient with various analysis software, capable of conducting multi-dimensional analysis and making informed business judgments.

3. Market insight: information sensitivity to the market and industry, able to capture development trends, and formulate strategies.

4. Project management ability: good at communication and expression, strong coordination, team consciousness, and organizational ability.

5. English or Portuguese can be used as working languages.


What Make This Role Exciting:

1. A startup team with plenty of opportunities to participate in core projects for rapid growth. 2. Experiencing different countries, languages, and cultures.


The following are preferred:

1. Experience in the food delivery industry and the local-based service industry is preferred. 2. Proficient in using SQL or other data analysis tools. 3. Experience in merchant operations/strategy operations/product operations preferred.

title: Coordenador/a de Planejamento Tributário (Tributos Diretos)
description:
Estamos com uma oportunidade de Coordenador/a de Planejamento Tributário, com foco em Tributos Diretos, que contribuirá estrategicamente para a competitividade tributária e a segurança fiscal da companhia. Este/a profissional atuará em regime presencial no nosso escritório sede localizado na Zona Sul da cidade de São Paulo/SP, tendo estas atribuições principais:


  • Realizar estudos avançados voltados à competitividade tributária do negócio grandes projetos de infraestrutura civil e industrial;
  • Atuar junto aos diversos ambientes e projetos que compõem a empresa de forma a garantir a segurança empresarial e mitigação de exposições fiscais;
  • Ser ponto focal para as áreas da empresa nos quesitos de Planejamento Tributário, com sólidos conhecimentos de IRPJ/CSLL corrente e diferido, PIS/COFINS regime cumulativo e não cumulativo, IOF, CPRB, diferimento de órgãos públicos e Impostos Retidos;
  • Estudar e avaliar impactos tributários de operações diversas (p.e. exportação, importação, cessão de créditos, assunção de dívidas, variação cambial, empréstimos/mútuos, caixa, receitas financeiras, ressarcimentos, rateio de despesas/cost sharing, entre outros);
  • Apoiar na elaboração de memorandos técnicos com a visão tributária para suporte aos registros contábeis;
  • Analisar impactos tributários em operações de reestruturação societária e redução de saldos intercompany (em conjunto com a Contabilidade);
  • Revisar notas explicativas das Demonstrações Financeiras, analisar e qualificar as variações dos saldos das contas relacionadas aos impostos;
  • Projetar e acompanhar impostos (orçado x realizado);
  • Analisar e aplicar teses tributárias (em conjunto com Jurídico);
  • Apoiar no atendimento às fiscalizações, auditoria interna e externa;
  • Mapear riscos tributários e atuar na correção de processos;
  • Monitorar alterações na legislação fiscal e estimar os impactos nos projetos/negócios;
  • Avaliar adesão a Parcelamentos e Transações Tributárias (projeções/cálculos);


Perfil Requerido:

  • Formação Superior em Ciências Contábeis, Ciências Econômicas, Administração, Direito ou áreas correlatas;
  • Desejável MBA e / ou Especialização em Gestão Tributária ou Planejamento Tributário;
  • Necessário deter experiência profissional em Planejamento Tributário de tributos diretos;
  • Será considerado diferencial, conhecimentos em REIDI, ICMS, IPI, ISS, TBU, TP (Transfer Pricing), Pillar Two, CBC-R e Materfile;
  • Conhecimentos avançados nos principais softwares do Pacote Office;
  • Vivência pregressa com sistemas da plataforma Oracle será um diferencial;
  • Desejável possuir conhecimentos avançados em inglês e espanhol;
  • Disponibilidade / mobilidade para atuar em regime presencial na Zona Sul da cidade de São Paulo/SP.



Sobre a Odebrecht :


A Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção é uma empresa que presta serviços nos segmentos de construção civil pesada e construção, montagem e manutenção de empreendimentos industriais, sediada no Brasil e atende além deste país, outros quatro mercados: Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos. Composta por mais de 20 mil Integrantes, a Odebrecht gera oportunidades de trabalho para as populações locais e contribui para o desenvolvimento sustentável de cada região, atuando nas seguintes áreas:


✔ Transporte e Logística

✔ Energia

✔ Saneamento

✔ Engenharia Industrial

✔ Desenvolvimento Urbano e Edificações



Nossa Cultura :


A Nossa Cultura é um conjunto de princípios, conceitos e critérios, com foco na educação e no trabalho, que provê os fundamentos éticos, morais e conceituais para a atuação dos integrantes do Grupo. Valorizamos potencialidades do ser humano, como a disposição para servir, a capacidade e o desejo de evoluir e a vontade de superar resultados. Acreditamos, com convicção e determinação, que a prática da Cultura Odebrecht e das nossas políticas, com atuação ética, íntegra e transparente e o compromisso em promover a diversidade, nos fortalecem e aumentam a nossa competitividade, no rumo da sobrevivência, do crescimento e da perpetuidade.

title: Analista Contábil
description:
Como Analista Contábil, você apoiará a equipe Financeira nos processos contábeis internos, incluindo:

title: Purchasing Analyst
description:
About us


OPPO was founded in 2004 and is one of the global leaders in smart device innovation.

Supplier Management

title: ANALISTA DE MERCHANDISING SÊNIOR
description:
Acreditamos que um time diverso é mais capaz de gerar valor e ser resiliente, por isso nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas. Vem ser Iguatemi! A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 14 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 3 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.


⛳ MISSÃO DO CARGO


Responsável por conduzir os processos da cadeia de compra das coleções e acompanhamento dos indicadores da área de produto, como OTB, compras, vendas, cash flow, margem, Sell Thru e loss end. Garantir a correta precificação e alocação de produtos na loja, bem como treinamento de equipe e analise de mercado. Ter contato direto com a loja e demais áreas que possuem interação para garantir o alinhamento 360° em relação a produto e a otimização da venda/giro.

Responsável pela movimentação de peças nos diferentes estoque (inclusive entre lojas da mesma marca), garantindo a acuracidade da oferta em cada canal.

Responsável pela interface com o Iguatemi365, no tange os KPIs da área: oferta, precificação, disponibilidade de produtos, giro, venda por produto.


OBSERVAÇÕES


  • Conhecimentos técnicos sólidos em Excel (ser avançado é mandatório);
  • Inglês avançado é mandatório;
  • Formação: Administração, Marketing, Engenharia, Economia, e áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimentos:
  • Conhecimentos de consumidor e tendências de comportamento;
  • Conhecimentos técnicos elementares em moda e mercado de luxo;


RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?


  • Realizar a concepção do OTB (open to buy) diante da projeção e vendas determinada, considerando marca, coleções, categorias, subcategorias, itens, grade. Para acuracidade, deve considerar analise de histórico e tendências;
  • Realizar o processo de compra de produtos. Receber material da nova coleção, entender a inspiração junto a marca, analisar vendas e definir qual será o investimento de cada categoria (+subcategoria, itens, grade). Avaliar tendências e integrar equipe de varejo na definição dos produtos;
  • Realizar a precificação de produtos em linha com as premissas definidas e alinhadas com a marca e internamente determinadas pela iRetail. Sugerir as premissas adequadas para cada marca e momento, para tanto é necessário entender o mercado, analisar concorrência, para garantir que atingiremos os resultados definidos em budget;
  • Estar frequentemente em loja para acompanhar as vendas dos produtos junto à equipe de loja (in loco na loja), tanto quanti quanto qualitativamente, avaliar a exposição dos mesmos, reforçar o treinamento da equipe sobre a marca e os produtos. Propor sugestões de ações internas para melhoria do giro dos produtos (KPI); conectar frequentemente com Varejo e Marketing para discutir oportunidade e viabilidade das ações. Proatividade na busca de soluções para melhor girar produto;
  • Acompanhar o mercado de varejo, como ações e preços de concorrentes. Fazer uma análise crítica com relação ao que estamos praticando e, se necessário, propor mudanças;
  • Responsável pelo conhecimento das informações relacionadas a produto, assim como o treinamento da equipe. Garantir o conhecimento de todos os envolvidos no prazo necessário para que consigam agir em suas respectivas áreas;
  • Conhecer as clientes das marcas sob sua responsabilidade (grau de relacionamento de acordo com a tipo de cliente, as principais clientes precisa conhecer pessoalmente, ter relacionamento);
  • Garantir junto a área de Operações o recebimento dos produtos nos prazos necessários. Acompanhar todos os embarques e entender impactos de possíveis atrasos nos recebimentos e lidar com o Controle de Qualidade (processos, interface loja, com a marca e solicitar os devidos reembolsos);
  • Participar e contribuir em ações da marca (como eventos etc), garantindo excelência e ganho de conhecimento;
  • Garantir acuracidade nas informações quantitativas e qualitativas, na frequência demandada, dos relatórios e calls com as marcas, garantindo repasse de informação sobre nosso negocio;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente ágil e dinâmico com altas demandas;
  • Disponibilidade para viajar internacionalmente para os markets das marcas - frequência de 1x por semestre.

title: Senior Network Designer
description:
Senior Network Designer

Location: São Paulo – Villa Lobos

Flexible Working / Hybrid – Office and Remote combination



Why this role matters

At BT International, We serve customers in over 180 countries, helping multinational businesses transform digitally. We deliver secure, high-performance networks and IT solutions that connect people and data wherever they are.

Our strategy is to be brilliant in what we do best , making it easier for customers to work with us , and delivering scalable, repeatable solutions backed by outstanding service and market-leading security .

As a Network Designer Analyst , you’ll be at the heart of this journey — designing technical solutions that meet customer needs, support growth, and shape the future of digital connectivity.


What you’ll be doing

In this role, you will:

  • Work on solution designs for customer projects, mainly in-life services but also new builds and transformations.
  • Design and deliver technical solutions that align with governance and gold standards.
  • Ensure your designs are scalable, adaptable, and cost-effective.
  • Escalate risks or cost issues when needed.
  • Present and explain technical designs to internal and external audiences.
  • Collaborate across offices and remote teams to deliver exceptional service.


Your responsibilities

  • Capture and translate business requirements into high-quality technical solutions.
  • Contribute to issue resolution during design and delivery phases.
  • Review and validate new and in-life products and services.
  • Support customer migration planning, change management, and impact assessments.
  • Troubleshoot and support resolution of technical issues, including root cause analysis.
  • Ensure all designs follow architectural principles and strategy.
  • Suggest and support improvements to internal processes.


Skills & experience we’re looking for

Core skills – We should be able to work independently on the following matters:

  • Requirements gathering & analysis
  • Solution design
  • Business analysis & commercial awareness
  • Troubleshooting & root cause analysis
  • Technology migration
  • Change and incident management


Soft skills & mindset

  • Strong communication & presentation skills
  • Ability to negotiate and develop proposals
  • Growth mindset & continuous learning attitude
  • Inclusive, collaborative approach to teamwork
  • Learning agility — adapt quickly to new tools and technologies


Technical knowledge

  • +5 years’ experience in network technologies & protocols
  • Design and deploy network routing & switching components (LAN, WAN, WLAN – SDWAN is a plus)
  • Valid CCNP or equivalent certification from networks technologies / vendors
  • Understanding enterprise IT and cloud-based environments
  • Advanced English is mandatory


What’s in it for you

  • Opportunity to design solutions that impact global industries.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge technologies
  • Career growth in solution design and architecture.
  • Work with a diverse, international team shaping the future of digital transformation.


If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, designing innovative customer solutions, and want to grow your career in a global, collaborative environment, this role is for you!

title: Analista de Operações de Crédito
description:
Sobre a Ótmow

Na Ótmow, estamos revolucionando o acesso a capital para quem vende ao setor público. Somos uma fintech em ritmo acelerado, especializada na antecipação de notas fiscais performadas para fornecedores de prefeituras, estados e governo federal. Combinamos tecnologia, inteligência de dados e conhecimento do setor para oferecer soluções financeiras seguras, ágeis e alinhadas à realidade de quem move os serviços públicos no Brasil.


Suas responsabilidades

  • Avaliar, liberar e acompanhar operações de crédito.
  • Realizar análise de garantias dos cedentes e sacados (públicos).
  • Definir limites de crédito de acordo com o valor tomado e perfil da operação.
  • Construir materiais e relatórios para o Comitê de Crédito.
  • Fazer a gestão do portfólio de crédito, acompanhando performance e riscos.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com as áreas Comercial, Tech e Jurídico, garantindo fluidez e padronização dos processos.
  • Atuar na gestão administrativa das operações, assegurando aderência a políticas internas e normas regulatórias.
  • Contribuir para a construção e melhoria contínua de processos internos.


O que buscamos em você

  • Perfil analítico, com capacidade crítica para avaliação de risco.
  • Dinamismo e flexibilidade para atuar em cenários de mudança rápida.
  • Boa comunicação, com habilidade para interação com diferentes áreas e stakeholders.
  • Experiência prévia no mercado financeiro, crédito ou operações estruturadas.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e colaborar em um ambiente multicultural.
  • Organização e atenção a detalhes, com foco em eficiência operacional.
  • Vontade de construir e escalar processos em uma fintech em crescimento.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em análise de crédito corporativo.
  • Vivência com operações de banco, fundos, mercado de capitais ou fintech.
  • Familiaridade com gestão de portfólio e indicadores de risco.
  • Comunicação em inglês.


Por que trabalhar na Ótmow

  • Ambiente dinâmico e inovador, com autonomia para construir e deixar sua marca.
  • Time colaborativo e multicultural, conectado por um propósito comum.
  • Oportunidade de crescer junto com uma fintech em expansão.

title: ANALISTA DE TESOURARIA CORPORATIVA PL
description:
Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.


Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #JeitoCogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.


Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Elaborar o fluxo de caixa mensal consolidado e das unidades de negócio da companhia;
  • Suporte na elaboração do orçamento anual de caixa;
  • Participar do processo de forecast mensal das unidades de negócio;
  • Analisar o real vs. orçado do fluxo de caixa operacional e seus respectivos desvios;
  • Elaboração de apresentações mensais para a diretoria;
  • Dar suporte na otimização dos processos existentes de apuração de fluxo de caixa mensal.



Além disso, é muito importante que você tenha:

  • Ensino Superior completo em administração, economia, ciências contábeis ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência com ERPs: SAP / XRT / HYPERION;
  • Bons conhecimentos de Fluxo de Caixa Direto e Indireto;
  • Pacote Office Avançado, principalmente Excel e PowerPoint.


Será um diferencial:

  • Experiência em funções de Tesouraria, Controladoria, FP&A;
  • Experiência em empresas de capital aberto ou Big Four;
  • Power BI e outras ferramentas de BI;
  • Inglês Avançado;
  • VBA e Macros.


Informações adicionais

Modelo de trabalho presencial em nosso escritório na Av. Paulista.


O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.


Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.



Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Java Sênior
description:
Sobre a Motivus


Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais. Nossas equipes são dedicadas a impulsionar a sustentabilidade, expandir os limites da tecnologia e construir a próxima geração de soluções digitais de classe mundial que capacitam nossos clientes e geram impacto duradouro. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você trabalhará com profissionais visionários comprometidos em criar soluções inovadoras que moldam o futuro da indústria.


Visão Geral da Posição


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Java Sênior para se juntar à nossa equipe dinâmica. Nesse cargo, você será responsável por desenvolver e manter sistemas de antifraude, além de oferecer suporte aos gestores de negócios e aos times de canais em integrações técnicas e durante os ciclos de certificação das aplicações. Você colaborará com equipes diversificadas, incentivará a comunicação multifuncional e contribuirá para projetos que terão um impacto significativo em nossos clientes e na indústria.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver sistemas de antifraude.
  • Apoiar na definição funcional e de UX, buscando a melhor experiência para o cliente.
  • Apoiar gestores de negócios nas definições funcionais e no suporte das aplicações.
  • Dar suporte aos times de canais em problemas técnicos de integração com ferramentas de prevenção a fraudes.
  • Atuar junto aos times de canais na análise e identificação de problemas técnicos durante os ciclos de certificação das aplicações.
  • Realizar correção de incidentes relacionados à prevenção a fraudes e garantir a devida tratativa.


Qualificações


  • Experiência em desenvolvimento Java.
  • Integração com serviços backend (API/REST).
  • Desenvolvimento de microserviços.
  • Conhecimento em frameworks: Spring, Spring Boot, Hibernate (ou equivalentes).
  • Integração com serviços SOAP/REST (cliente e servidor).
  • Comunicação via MQ (RabbitMQ, Kafka, etc).
  • Conhecimentos em design patterns e padrões de arquitetura.
  • Bancos de dados: Oracle, Redis, MongoDB, NoSQL, DocumentDB, DynamoDB.
  • Vivência com Cloud Services (AWS, Azure, OpenShift).


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?


  • Desenvolva sua Carreira: Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes: Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo: Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento: Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo(a) a progredir em sua carreira.
  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente: Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.


Nossos Valores


  • Cultura de Inovação: Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.
  • Responsabilidade: Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento: Nossos colaboradores lideram, aprendem e crescem, apoiando a si mesmos e a nossos clientes.


Como se Candidatar


Os(as) candidatos(as) interessados(as) podem se inscrever enviando seu currículo e carta de apresentação para ou através deste anúncio.


A Motivus é um empregador que promove a igualdade de oportunidades e incentiva a diversidade e inclusão no local de trabalho.

title: Consultor SAP MM
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP MM Consultant, who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will:

  • Stay updated on the latest SAP MM features, enhancements, and industry trends to continuously improve integration solutions and practices;
  • Develop and implement specific customizations to meet local requirements and ensure compliance with Brazilian regulations;
  • Provide ongoing technical support to end users, resolving issues and collaborating on effective solutions;
  • Develop training materials and conduct training sessions for key users, ensuring adequate knowledge of the functionalities;
  • Create reports and analysis of data relevant, providing important insights for strategic decision making;
  • Providing a creative source of ideas/solutions to address customer issues;
  • Delivering billable components that meets a customer’s needs;
  • Ensure standard solution usage whenever it´s possible. Be able to provide workarounds when SAP standard solutions do not fit to customer scenarios;
  • Evaluate affected processes and scenarios. Ensure proper validation of solution implemented by grating minimum test case scenarios execution;
  • Get involved with customer scenarios, be able to understand business needs and discuss best approaches to help them;
  • Collaborate with Technical, Data Migration e Test Teams;
  • Document technical specifications, design documents, and deployment procedures for integration solutions;
  • Assist in the deployment and go-live activities of integration projects, including providing support during the post-go-live phase;
  • Perform unit testing, debugging, and troubleshooting to ensure high-quality deliverables;
  • Work closely with other project teams like Technical, Data Migration and Test Leads to help and support on their Technical activities;
  • Stay updated with the latest SAP technologies and best practices to continuously improve development processes;
  • Participate in system integration testing and support deployment activities;
  • Document technical specifications, configurations, and development activities;
  • Perform Reviews for performance optimization, and best practices;


And much better if you stand out for:

  • English Advanced
  • Solid expertise in SAP ECC or S/4Hana focused on knowledge in SAP-MM, purchasing processes, inventory and integration with other SAP modules and interfaces;
  • Experience in configuration of SAP MM integration especially with SD and FI modules;
  • Experience in Brazilian legislation related to taxes regulation, and fiscal obligations is mandatory;
  • Ability to address customer requirements in purchasing, inventory, transfer between plants (including 3PL), imports and intercompany processes areas for cross industries;
  • Be able to provide remote/onsite SAP consulting services to key SAP customers on innovative products;
  • Knowledge of IMG configuration, design/execute implementation packages (e.g., RDS´s, best practices implementation guides);
  • Be able to understand complex business scenarios and propose SAP standard solutions or workarounds;
  • Experience working with SAP Implementation or Rollout projects;
  • Understanding SAP Best Practices and have knowledge in multiple modules, their integrations & technology;


Desirable Skills:

  • Knowledge on HANA database, knowledge on basic HANA tools (HANA studio) for navigation and scenarios identification;
  • Certified in SAP MM;
  • Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline
  • Leadership skills with ability to influence and negotiate internal and external stakeholders;
  • Should be proficient in conversation on various aspects of technology and architecture with business leads, IT leads;
  • Work effectively in multiple time zones with global teams;
  • Experience working in SAP Activate methodology;
  • Spanish language skills will be appreciated.

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento Pleno (Brasil)
description:

Presente internacionalmente em mais de 80 países, é uma empresa inovadora focada em ajudar os tutores de pets a tomarem as melhores decisões nutricionais personalizadas para o bem-estar de seus animais.

  • Desenvolver soluções de IA em Python com foco em machine learning e deep learning.
  • Integrar e consumir APIs para sistemas internos e externos.
  • Implementar e otimizar modelos de LLMs em aplicações de negócio.
  • Criar pipelines de treinamento, validação e deploy de modelos em produção.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para soluções escaláveis de IA.

  • Residir no estado de São Paulo (SP).
  • Disponibilidade para viagens esporádicas e de curta duração.

title: Analista de Relações Sindicais Sênior
description:
Orgulho de ser Camil!


É com a força dos mais de 6 mil colaboradores presentes no Brasil, Uruguai, Chile, Peru, Equador e Paraguai que estamos rumo a um futuro promissor. Gente do passado, presente e futuro, foram e continuarão sendo fundamentais para a construção da nossa empresa que, sem deixar de ser simples, continua crescendo e inovando.


Estamos mais fortes do que nunca e acreditamos que através da riqueza que há nas pessoas, engajamos o nosso time para continuar alcançando os melhores resultados.


Nossas vagas estão abertas para todas e todos, independentemente da idade, deficiência, raça, gênero ou orientação sexual.


Venha construir uma carreira de sucesso!



Atividades:

  • Liderar tecnicamente análises de questões ligadas a processos trabalhistas e sindicais objetivando redução de possíveis ações;
  • Propor e implementar melhorias no processo, assegurando o alinhamento aos objetivos e definições estratégicas da empresa;
  • Representar a empresa junto a órgãos públicos, sindicatos, Justiça e Ministério do Trabalho;
  • Participar de reuniões e negociações sindicais;
  • Atuar de forma preventiva, com foco em propor alternativas para redução/mitigação e eliminação de riscos e passivo trabalhista e sindical através do monitoramento e elaboração de relatórios sobre líderes naturais;
  • Elaborar material e conduzir treinamentos utilizando de casos práticos para melhor absorção de conhecimento com foco em mitigação de risco trabalhista;
  • Analisar e dar pareceres relacionados à atualização da legislação e jurisprudência trabalhista com foco no impacto para a empresa bem como avaliação de oportunidades e obrigações legais, evitando passivo e fazendo um trabalho preventivo, sempre que ocorrer uma alteração na legislação;
  • Desenvolver estudos e implantar novas ferramentas de gestão em recursos humanos, bem como aprimorar as ferramentas já existentes, definindo metodologias para seu desenvolvimento/aprimoramento e padrões a serem adotados, buscando inovação;
  • Elaborar pareceres, contratos de trabalho, respostas de ofícios e assessoramento na redação dos Acordos Coletivos, bem como, nas Políticas e Normas internas, mantendo estas em consonância com a legislação e Acordos e Convenções Coletivas de Trabalho;
  • Analisar e dar pareceres relacionados às Convenções e Acordos Coletivas além de participar ativamente das negociações sindicais e buscando no dia a dia um bom relacionamento entre o sindicato e as entre as áreas internas;
  • Atualizar controle de ACT CCT após a finalização das negociações e preparar informações sobre as negociações para a folha de pagamento;
  • Monitorar e acompanhar os processos de auxílio-doença junto ao INSS, garantindo o recebimento dos benefícios pelos colaboradores e o cumprimento dos prazos;
  • Fornecer informações e suporte à gestão para a tomada de decisões relacionadas a afastamentos, como substituição de funcionários e planejamento de tarefas.

title: Sales Engineer
description:
Important note: Although this role is remote, the ideal candidate will be in Rio De Janeiro or Sao Paulo.

*Please apply with English CV/Resume*


Absolute Software is looking for a Sales Engineer (SE) to provide technical sales support as a solution expert within our fast-growing India business. The SE is a highly technical sales professional who is responsible for working with Account Executives (AEs) and Channel Account Managers (CAMs) to drive significant revenue growth within the region.


What We’re Looking For:

The Sales Engineer (SE) manages the technical sales process, primarily during the discovery and validation stages of the sales process. The SE is a technical evangelist for our software platform, representing the company with potential customers, partners, and at events.


You are skilled at performing detailed discovery that uncovers the customers’ current state and negative consequences, understanding their desired future state and positive business outcomes, and positioning technical solutions that provide real business value. You can tailor demonstrations to align with the discovered pain. You can build Proof of Value (PoV) plans that validate the solution is strongly aligned with the customer needs and delivers quantifiable business value. You can work with the customer to lead the PoV, and then partner with your Account Executive (AE) and Channel Account Manager (CAM) to deliver a strong PoV summary document and wrap-up presentation. You can smoothly handle objections while remaining focused on the important differentiators. Finally, you can effectively build technical champions inside accounts and operate independently of, but in partnership with your AE and CAM.

You will be expected to quickly come up to speed on our Absolute Secure Endpoint (Visibility, Control, Resilience) and Secure Access product offerings (Absolute VPN, Absolute ZTNA and Absolute Insights for Network). Your deep product knowledge, as well as in-depth knowledge of security, networking, and operating systems will help you to effectively position our products, while also helping to solve difficult technical problems for potential customers during pre-sales presentations, demonstrations, and evaluations.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with your Account Executives and Channel Account Managers to establish and execute sales strategy for your territory and key partners
  • Deliver tailored technical sales presentations and demonstrations to prospective customers and partners
  • Plan and execute Proof of Value (PoV, evaluation) activities. This includes scoping the PoV to align with the business pain, defining relevant success criteria and metrics, designing the PoV environment, installing and configuring Absolute Secure Access and Secure Endpoint products, providing technical support to prospective customers, and executing the PoV in accordance with the agreed-upon success criteria
  • Working with your leadership, communicate feature requests and product ideas, backed by data from your sales engagements, into product management. Assist your leadership in working with product management to develop priorities for the company's product roadmap
  • Partnering with your AE and CAM, document the ongoing sales cycles and PoVs in Salesforce.com
  • Collaborate and education technical peers within Channel partners help uncover new sales opportunities
  • Protect the security and privacy of Absolute and its customers

Skills and experience:

  • Experience with complex technical sales cycles, including deep discovery as well as scoping, executing, and presenting complex Proof of Value (evaluations)
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to all levels of people, from IT, Network and Security managers to Line of Business owners to CIO and CISOs
  • Understanding of data-in-transit security, including TLS, IPsec, VPNs, PKI, and certificate management
  • Understanding of network services and systems including routing and local and wide area network design Familiar with popular firewall vendors and basic rule design
  • Understanding of authentication methods and protocols including SAML and RADIUS
  • Understanding of AV, EDR, Incident Response, Forensics, or other endpoint or network security tools
  • Familiar with popular firewall vendors and basic rule design
  • Familiar with endpoint security and patch management policies
  • Strong understanding of Windows (Desktop and Server), macOS, and Linux operating systems, including network stacks
  • Can troubleshoot complex network environments to support evaluations on customers’ premise or with the Absolute cloud hosted products
  • Fluent verbal and written communication in English, Spanish and Portuguese

Nice to have:

  • Experience with selling methodologies such as Command of the Message and MEDDPICC
  • Experience selling SASE, SSE, VPN, EDR, Incident Response or other endpoint or network security tools
  • Experience with programming or scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash
  • Experience with Cloud IaaS vendors including networking and security service operation
  • Security (CISSP, GIAC, CompTIA Security+, etc) or networking (CCNA, CompTIA Network+, etc) certifications
  • Experience in IT or Security operations


Why Work For Us:

You’re resilient and passionate about securing the Work from Anywhere era. So are we.

We’re in search of the best and the brightest – everyone from innovators, sellers and marketers to financers, operators and especially customer relationship managers – we’re looking for top tier talent to help us shape the next decade of security, drive innovation that enables customers with truly disruptive solutions and are dedicated to making a meaningful difference.

Headquartered in Seattle, Washington with international offices in Vancouver - BC, Austin - TX, Ankeny – IA, Reading - UK and Ho Chi Minh City – Vietnam, Absolute Security accelerates customers’ shift to work-from-anywhere through the industry’s first self-healing Zero Trust platform, ensuring maximum security and uncompromised productivity. Only Absolute is embedded in more than half a billion devices, offering a permanent digital connection that intelligently and dynamically applies visibility, control and self-healing capabilities to endpoints, applications, and network access to ensure their cyber resilience tailored for distributed workforces.

Our vision is to be the world’s most trusted security company – and to empower end users to connect securely and from anywhere, to all the applications they need to collaborate and get their work done, without interruptions and with an optimal network experience. Absolute currently serves approximately 16,000 customers with more than 13 million activated endpoints globally. G2 Recognized Absolute as a Leader in the Summer 2025 Endpoint Management and Zero Trust Networking Grid Reports, reflecting our continued customer satisfaction across product lines. Além dos controles de caixa e riscos, a Tesouraria tem como objetivo a constante avaliação do melhor modelo de gestão de recursos e a otimização o P&L da empresa, por meio da diversificação das estratégias de investimentos e captações de recursos com taxas e spreads mais competitivas.

  • Benchmark de custo financeiro, spread bancário médio e outros KPIs entre empresas do mesmo setor;

  • Desenvolver e implementar melhoria processos visando melhoria na qualidade e produtividade
  • Interação periódica e preparação de reportes mensais para o time de ALM global;
  • Conhecimentos em mercado de capitais;
  • Experiencia em cálculos financeiros (juros simples, exponencial, ;

Realizar a prática da coleta seletiva no setor, cumprir com a política, objetivos, procedimentos e diretrizes ambientais, ter conhecimento dos seus aspectos e impactos ambientais significativos, contribuir com melhorias voltadas a proteção do meio ambiente e multiplicar o conhecimento sobre as melhores práticas ambientais sempre que possível a todos os colaboradores que atuam em sua área.

description:
What is Teachable ?


Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


About your Team

Growth Marketing at Teachable focuses on bringing more creators to our platform by optimizing each step of the growth funnel. We work closely with Product, Partnerships and Brand & Content, in a fast-paced, results-driven environment. We embrace testing new hypotheses, fail fast and quickly apply those learnings through a very data-driven approach. We're always adapting as both our company and industry continue to evolve, while keeping the ultimate goal of connecting with and supporting creators.


What is the role?

We are looking for a strategic and data-driven Business Analyst to join our Marketing Analytics team. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for translating complex marketing and business data into actionable insights that drive our growth strategy. You will leverage your structured problem-solving approach and analytical mindset to partner within the Growth, Brand, Partnerships, Product, Data and Finance teams to develop and implement measurement frameworks, analyze performance. You will identify strategic opportunities for optimization which you’re likely to lead or advise all the way through implementation.

This position reports to the Marketing Analytics Lead and plays a crucial role in fostering a data-driven decision-making culture throughout the organization.


Additionally, this position will collaborate with US based employees on a daily basis, so fluency in English is required.


In this role you'll:

  • Build and maintain impactful marketing dashboards using Sigma, Google Analytics, Heap, and Looker that drive business decisions
  • Analyze marketing campaigns across channels to optimize performance and allocation of resources
  • Define and track key metrics (LTV, CAC, Churn, Retention, Conversion Rates) to evaluate business health
  • Design and analyze A/B tests to optimize conversion funnels and marketing effectiveness
  • Own weekly reporting processes to deliver insights to stakeholders, including executive leadership
  • Help develop and improve attribution models to better understand marketing ROI and customer journeys

Zubale is a technology company that enables retailers to win in eCommerce. We serve a wide range of retailers from supermarkets, specialty stores, pharmacies, department stores and fashion brands across Mexico, Brazil, Chile, Costa Rica, Peru and Colombia. How? We have three key products:

Backed by over $70M USD in venture capital, we’ve delivered consistent growth over the past six years and completed more than 100 million orders through our platform. Today, we serve 100+ customers and engage thousands of freelancers across our network. And this is just the beginning. We're building a profitable, scalable ecosystem — and our vision is to become the #1 partner for retailers to grow their eCommerce business.

title: LATAM Training Supervisor
description:
Join Our Team as a LATAM Training Supervisor!


Are you a proactive individual with a talent for building relationships and achieving results? We are seeking a dynamic Training Supervisor to lead the development and implementation of high-quality training programs for our customers, distributors, and partners. You will work closely with our Service Manager to transform training needs into successes, executing innovative training strategies and ensuring exceptional training experiences.


The Big Picture (Purpose):


The Training Supervisor will be instrumental in developing and executing high-quality training programs tailored for our customers, distributors, and partners. This role is dedicated to enhancing the knowledge and skills of stakeholders, ensuring they are equipped with the necessary expertise to use, promote, and support Alliance Laundry products effectively. The Training Supervisor will collaborate with various departments to identify key training needs, create engaging educational content, and deliver impactful training sessions using a variety of mediums. By fostering strong relationships and providing exceptional training experiences, the Training Supervisor will help strengthen brand loyalty, improve partner performance, and drive the overall success of Alliance Laundry in the marketplace.


What You’ll Be Doing (Responsibilities):


  • Identify training needs by analyzing performance evaluations and gathering feedback from customers.
  • Develop and implement comprehensive technical training programs that align with the company's strategic objectives.
  • Coordinate logistics for training sessions, including scheduling, venue arrangements, and procurement of necessary materials.
  • Manage the training budget effectively to optimize resource allocation and utilization.
  • Deliver training sessions through various formats, including in-person workshops, webinars, and lectures.
  • Select and oversee external instructors or facilitators as needed to ensure high-quality training delivery.
  • Develop and utilize evaluation tools, such as quizzes and surveys, to assess the effectiveness of training programs.
  • Gather and analyze participant feedback to continuously refine and improve training content and delivery.
  • Maintain detailed records of training activities, including participant engagement and outcomes.
  • Prepare regular reports on training progress and its impact on partner and stakeholder performance.
  • Collaborate with different departments to ensure alignment of training initiatives with organizational goals.
  • Participate in strategic meetings to discuss the development and deployment of technicians throughout Brazil and the Latin American region.
  • Actively recruit new technicians to address coverage gaps in underserved areas.
  • Manage resources and maintain relationships with ABRALAV to support training initiatives.
  • Work closely with the North American Training Group to ensure alignment and leverage shared resources and strategies.
  • Collaborate with the LATAM marketing team to provide technical validation, ensuring the accuracy of marketing materials.


What you need to bring to the table (Experience):


Education & Experience:


  • Knowledge of Chemistry, mechanics, electrical, electronics and pneumatics.
  • Experience with deepwater oil extraction equipment, corrosion protection systems, programming and configuration of professional laundry equipment software, general maintenance and application of training for professional laundry maintenance technicians.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).



Skills and Abilities:


  • Service-oriented: understands customer issues and is willing to help.
  • Strong ability to work independently and manage workload effectively.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in Spanish and English.
  • Practical knowledge of mechanics, electronics, and electrical systems.
  • Ability to work with others, assertive and diplomatic.
  • Must be able to travel up to 70% of the time.



Standard and Physical Requirements:


  • Position may involve standing for long periods, manual dexterity, stooping, bending.
  • Position requires the ability to lift, carry, push, and pull up to 50 lbs. rarely. For greater weight items assistive devices will be provided.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear; and use hands to manipulate objects or controls. Specific conditions of this job are typical of frequent and continuous computer-based work requiring periods of sitting; close vision, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Must have a clean Motor Vehicle Record.

  • Innovative: Always looking for a better way; leads change.

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor


Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity
